title: validate_session_urls rejects non-http/https scheme in server-supplied URLs
description: After fetching the JMAP Session object, validate_session_urls() checks that all four server-supplied URL fields (apiUrl, uploadUrl, downloadUrl, eventSourceUrl) use http or https scheme. The code comment names the threat explicitly: 'prevents a malicious server from injecting non-HTTP URLs into subsequent requests (e.g. file://, ftp://)'. A contributor might remove this as over-engineering since 'who would send a file:// URL?' A MITM or compromised server could do exactly this to exfiltrate local files or redirect traffic to non-HTTP transports. The check is the correct defense-in-depth layer at the trust boundary where untrusted server data first enters the client. Do not remove.
